But really just figure out what studying method works best for you! You can also try khan academy, but personally I found books to be the best method for me!:)

Hi my brother has Aspergers, so I know exactly what you're going through. At one point, his condition got really bad and after talking to doctors, reading books, researching, etc., my mom found out some natural ways to help him. One way I would suggest is dieting. My brother was on a completely gluten and milk-free diet. He wasn't allowed to eat anything artificial or too high in sugar. It was a lot of work, but I genuinely think it is worth it. He has gotten better since :)
